meaning:
1) height, exaltation
1a) height
1b) exaltation, grandeur
1c) haughtiness

elsewhere.note: A champion out of the camp of the Philistines named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span went out.
The porch that was in front, its length, according to the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and the height one hundred twenty; and he overlaid it within…
They are high as heaven. What can you do? They are deeper than Sheol. What can you know?
The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.
Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.
“We have heard of the pride of Moab. He is very proud in his loftiness, his pride, his arrogance, and the arrogance of his heart.
As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around.
Yet I destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above…
